title: Crypto market data
summary: Token, wallet, pool and trade data aggregated across many vendors behind one API.

auth.hint: x-api-key header, injected by your own backend
auth.name: x-api-key

CRYPTO_DATA_API_KEY.description: Your crypto-data API key. Never written into this file.

nodes.title: Tokens
nodes.summary: Everything about one token: price, supply, holders and trades.

children.title: Holders
children.summary: Who owns a token and in what proportion.

children.title: Price and market cap
children.summary: Current and historical price, market cap and supply.

children.title: Lookup
children.summary: Turn a ticker or a name into the contract address everything else needs.

nodes.title: Wallets
nodes.summary: What a wallet holds, what it traded and what it made or lost.

children.title: Profit and loss
children.summary: Realized and unrealized profit for a wallet, overall or per token.
sampleQueries: how much did this wallet make

entries.name: holders_count
entries.title: Token holder count
entries.summary: Number of distinct wallets currently holding a token.
entries.description: Returns the count of unique addresses with a non-zero balance of the given token at the latest indexed block. Counts addresses, not people: one person may hold from several wallets, and contract, burn and exchange addresses are included unless you exclude them.

address.description: Token contract address or Solana mint.

chain.description: Which chain the token lives on.

excludeContracts.description: Leave out contract and burn addresses.

entries.returns: An integer count and the block height it was measured at.

relations.reason: share of supply per holder, not a count
who the largest holders actually are
if you only have a ticker, not an address

entries.name: holders_percentage
entries.title: Holder distribution
entries.summary: What share of supply each holder controls, as top-N or bucketed percentages.
entries.description: Returns the concentration of ownership: the percentage of circulating supply held by the top 1, 10, 50 and 100 wallets, plus an optional per-wallet breakdown. This is the number people usually mean when they ask whether a token is 'concentrated' or 'distributed'.

address.description: Token contract address or Solana mint.

entries.returns: A percentage of circulating supply per bucket, and the supply figure used.

relations.reason: the actual addresses behind the percentages

entries.name: holders_top
entries.title: Largest holders
entries.summary: The biggest wallets holding a token, with balance and share of supply.

address.description: Token contract address or Solana mint.

entries.returns: A ranked list of addresses with balance, share of supply and first-seen date.

relations.reason: what those wallets actually made on the token

cost.note: Scans the full holder set on large tokens.

entries.name: token_resolve_symbol
entries.title: Find a token by symbol or name
entries.summary: Turn a ticker like BONK into the contract address every other tool needs.
entries.description: Searches known tokens by symbol or name and returns candidates ranked by liquidity. Symbols are not unique: always check the returned market cap and liquidity before using a result.
entries.returns: Up to 10 candidate tokens with address, chain, liquidity and market cap.

entries.name: token_price
entries.title: Token price
entries.summary: Current USD price of a token, and the price a given time ago.

address.description: Token contract address or Solana mint.

at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp for a historical price. Omit for current.

entries.returns: A USD price, the source venue and the timestamp it applies to.

relations.reason: price times supply, if the question was about size not unit price
if you only have a ticker, not an address

entries.name: token_market_cap
entries.title: Token market cap
entries.summary: Market capitalisation of a token: price times circulating supply, in USD.

diluted.description: Use total supply instead of circulating.

entries.returns: A USD figure plus the price and supply used to compute it.

entries.name: wallet_pnl
entries.title: Wallet profit and loss
entries.summary: How much a wallet has made or lost overall, realized and unrealized, in USD.
entries.description: Computes profit and loss from the wallet's full trade history using FIFO cost basis. Unrealized profit uses current prices, so the figure moves with the market. Wallets with very long histories may take several seconds.
keywords: how much did this wallet make

since.description: RFC 3339 start of the window. Omit for all time.

entries.returns: Realized and unrealized USD profit, total invested, and the trade count behind it.

relations.reason: the same figure split per token, if you need to know which trade won

cost.note: Replays the wallet's whole trade history.

entries.name: wallet_pnl_by_token
entries.title: Wallet profit and loss per token
entries.summary: Profit and loss for a wallet broken down by each token it traded.
entries.returns: One row per token with realized, unrealized and total USD profit.
